memories.content: JobGhost 0.5.2 work on 2026-09-11: compact panel must be fixed inset0 height100dvh because parent header/padding clipped it; voice draft retained in compact composer. Native region picker captures desktop only on manual gesture and crops directly. API ask carries selected resume_id each request; letters now use selected API provider. OpenRouter models<=3; 700-token cap produced empty long responses, 4096 + low reasoning produced letter. Critical HH canary: GET /applicant/vacancy_response can itself trigger one-click application. Never navigate that URL in preflight. A real user-authorized canary showed applied but resume/letter delivery was not confirmed; recorded NEEDS_REVIEW, no retry. NBSP in 'Вы откликнулись' must normalize. Opening modal now guards writes/response navigation until resume+letter verified; SENDING/NEEDS_REVIEW block retry. Release remains pilot, not production; see audit TODO. Never retain user resume, cookies, audio, screenshots or keys in memory/repo.

memories.content: HH investigation 2026-09-11: autopilot skipped only APPLIED and could overwrite NEEDS_REVIEW by regenerating a letter and setting PREPARED; now skips all existing applications to preserve uncertain outcomes and user drafts. First-click guard treated all blocked POST analytics as attempted applications; those requests remain blocked but only response-like/navigation requests flag possible send. ValueError was hidden by generic CAPTCHA message; preserve actionable reason. Latest installed-update command was denied before execution: source and frozen hotfix built, installed runtime not updated. No real HH submission tested in this iteration.
memories.title: HH investigation 2026-09-11: autopilot skipped only APPLIED and could overwrite

memories.content: JobGhost context architecture: use SQLite as canonical materials/session storage and disposable in-memory Qdrant with multilingual FastEmbed. Avoid a second persistent copy of private documents and stale-vector resurrection after deletion. Session persistence is opt-in, bounded 30 turns; last four bounded turns enter prompt as untrusted dialog, never evidence of personal experience. API sessions isolate roles explicitly; an existing browser ChatGPT conversation cannot guarantee history isolation and requires a new chat.
memories.title: JobGhost context architecture: use SQLite as canonical materials/session storage
